# Penpa-edit compatibility fixture

Exact `COMPRESS_SUB` declaration excerpt from `docs/js/class_p.js` in penpa-edit at commit `b3444c3bbe3d393c6e5bd6de0cd920fe6234c8b5`. The MIT license and attribution are retained in `LICENSE`.

This snapshot pins the external format independently of Puzzle Kit and lets the parity test run in a standalone clone. To update, review the upstream declaration and copy it verbatim; do not generate it from `COMPRESS_SUBSTITUTIONS` in this repository.
